value.answer: There's no single 5-year fixed rate. It depends on the lender and on whether your mortgage is insured (under 20% down). The lowest insured rate is about 4.34% (as of Oct 9-12), and the lowest uninsured rate is about 4.44% (as of Oct 9). The big banks are higher, averaging around 5.14%, and BMO and CIBC just raised their 5-year fixed rates, so rates are climbing this month.
